description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Pappas Carriage”, a cozy Tuscan-style retreat perfectly situated in Rosemary Beach. Just 30 seconds from the white sands and a 2-min stroll to the Coquina Pool, this rental is thoughtfully designed for couples. Enjoy vaulted ceilings, modern mid-century décor, a charming balcony with Eastern Green views, and 2 guest bikes for exploring nearby shops and restaurants. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Directly in front of Eastern Green, offering scenic views30-second walk to the beach with restrooms2-minutes to Coquina Pool for a relaxing swimTuscan-inspired design with mid-century modern touchesPrivate balcony to enjoy morning coffee or evening sunsetsFully equipped kitchenette and cozy dining areaIncludes 2 bikes for exploring Rosemary BeachEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Location, location, location! Just steps from the beach and close to restaurants. Loved the charming vibe and relaxing balcony." – Heather R.⭐"Perfect getaway for 2! We walked everywhere and enjoyed coffee on the porch every morning. Ideal for couples." – Jill P.⭐"Adorable, cozy, and practically on the beach! Perfect for our anniversary trip. Can’t wait to come back." – Karen J.*** LIVING AREA ***Step inside Pappas Carriage, a Tuscan delight enhanced with vaulted ceilings and modern mid-century décor. Immerse yourself in a blend of Tuscan elegance and mid-century modern charm. The open living area is bathed in natural light, featuring vaulted ceilings and cozy furnishings—perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach or pool!Mid-century modern furniture and décorFlat-screen TV for movie nightsPrivate balcony with seating to enjoy morning coffee or sunsets*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The compact yet fully functional kitchenette is equipped with everything needed to enjoy home-cooked meals during your stay. A cozy dining nook provides an intimate setting for meals for two.Stainless Steel appliances including a mini fridge and gas rangeEssential cookware and utensilsCozy dining table for 2*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Queen Primary Suite: A cozy queen-sized bed to ensure restful nights. Vaulted ceilings and calming décor create the perfect atmosphere for relaxation.Full Bathroom: Modern bathroom featuring a curved shower and elegant finishes, a perfect blend of form and function.*** ADDITIONAL BOOKING INFORMATION ***Max Occupancy: This unit accommodates a maximum of 2 people. Additional overnight guests require prior approval from the management. An extra fee will apply for reservations exceeding the occupancy limit.Parking: The garage is shared with the main house & one space is available for the carriage house. There is additional street parking available at a first come, first serve basis.A main house is also available for rent. For more information, contact our 30A Escapes team to book.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Perfectly situated in Rosemary Beach, “Pappas Carriage” places you just steps from coffee shops, restaurants, and boutique stores. Hop on one of the included bikes to explore the beautiful surroundings, or walk 2 minutes to the Cabana Pool. With access to trails, parks, and the sparkling Emerald Coast, relaxation and adventure are always within reach.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during checkout or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThere is currently active construction across the green from this property.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 20818STRO #: STR-020818

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
